scope: data inventory and recommendations; no database writes; no new large dataset downloads; no social scraping; no model estimates
database_read_method: app.backend.database._read_json; separate READ ONLY transactions with fixed SELECT; encrypted login path; not one atomic multi-query snapshot

events.sql: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('n',COUNT(*),'held',SUM(event_status='held'),'cancelled',SUM(event_status='cancelled'),'postponed',SUM(event_status='postponed'),'missing_start',SUM(announced_show_start_time IS NULL),'missing_drone',SUM(has_drone_show IS NULL),'missing_related',SUM(related_activities IS NULL)) FROM taipei_metro_analysis.dadaocheng_fireworks_events;

weather_by_station.sql: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('station',s.station_id,'name',s.station_name,'rows',COUNT(*),'min',CAST(MIN(w.observed_at) AS CHAR),'max',CAST(MAX(w.observed_at) AS CHAR),'dates',COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(w.observed_at)),'temp',SUM(air_temperature_c IS NOT NULL),'rain',SUM(hourly_precipitation_mm IS NOT NULL),'wind',SUM(mean_wind_speed_m_s IS NOT NULL),'cloud',SUM(total_cloud_amount_tenths IS NOT NULL),'cloud_method_review',SUM(cloud_method_review_required),'end_unverified',SUM(time_alignment_status='end_of_day_unverified')) FROM taipei_metro_analysis.weather_observation w JOIN taipei_metro_analysis.weather_station s USING(station_id) GROUP BY s.station_id,s.station_name;

weather_missing_events.sql: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('date',CAST(e.event_date AS CHAR),'status',e.event_status) FROM taipei_metro_analysis.dadaocheng_fireworks_events e LEFT JOIN taipei_metro_analysis.event_weather_station m ON e.event_date=m.event_date AND m.station_role='primary' WHERE m.station_id IS NULL;

primary_weather.sql: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('events',COUNT(DISTINCT m.event_date),'rows',COUNT(*),'temp',SUM(w.air_temperature_c IS NOT NULL),'rain',SUM(w.hourly_precipitation_mm IS NOT NULL),'wind',SUM(w.mean_wind_speed_m_s IS NOT NULL),'cloud',SUM(w.total_cloud_amount_tenths IS NOT NULL)) FROM taipei_metro_analysis.event_weather_station m JOIN taipei_metro_analysis.weather_observation w ON m.station_id=w.station_id AND DATE(w.observed_at)=m.event_date WHERE m.station_role='primary';

baseline_by_station.sql: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('station',station,'events',COUNT(*),'complete',SUM(origin_window_complete),'baseline_missing',SUM(baseline_origin_window IS NULL),'min_days_0',SUM(baseline_min_days=0),'min_days_1',SUM(baseline_min_days=1),'min_days_2',SUM(baseline_min_days=2),'min_days_3',SUM(baseline_min_days=3),'min_days_4',SUM(baseline_min_days=4)) FROM taipei_metro_analysis.analysis_event_station_window WHERE station IN ('北門','大橋頭站','雙連','民權西路') AND window_start_hour=18 AND window_end_hour_exclusive=24 GROUP BY station;

baseline_events.sql: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('date',CAST(w.event_date AS CHAR),'status',e.event_status,'baseline_min_days',w.baseline_min_days,'baseline_missing',w.baseline_origin_window IS NULL) FROM taipei_metro_analysis.analysis_event_station_window w JOIN taipei_metro_analysis.dadaocheng_fireworks_events e ON e.event_date=w.event_date WHERE w.station='北門' AND w.window_start_hour=18 AND w.window_end_hour_exclusive=24 ORDER BY w.event_date;

weather_precipitation_flags.sql: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('status',precipitation_status,'n',COUNT(*)) FROM taipei_metro_analysis.weather_observation GROUP BY precipitation_status;

event_trends_counts.sql: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('imports',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM taipei_metro_analysis.google_trends_imports),'daily',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM taipei_metro_analysis.google_trends_daily),'features',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM taipei_metro_analysis.event_trends_features));

recommendations.proposed_fields_granularity_join: 同站同來源時段起站人次；`service_date + source_hour + station`，比較日再映射 `event_date`
recommendations.source_history_availability: [北捷官方月索引](https://data.taipei/api/frontstage/tpeod/dataset/resource.download?rid=eb481f58-1238-4cff-8caa-fa7bb20cb4f4)列有 201907、202306、202507；免費。尚未下載驗證內容
recommendations.cautions: 不含活動日／異常日，補下載不是新增獨立活動

recommendations.data_and_purpose: 氣溫、雨量、風、雲：描述；預測需當時預報
recommendations.proposed_fields_granularity_join: `station_id + observed_at`；先經 `event_weather_station(event_date, station_id)` 限 primary，再按確認的時間區間對齊
recommendations.source_history_availability: [CODiS](https://codis.cwa.gov.tw/StationData)可查歷史站資料；本專案已有 2017–2026 部分日期
recommendations.cautions: 雨量 T 是微量、& 是累積至後續，不當零；同時 join 2 站會放大人流列，雲量跨年測法須分開

recommendations.data_and_purpose: 國定假日、補班、連假：描述、預測
recommendations.proposed_fields_granularity_join: `calendar_date, is_holiday, is_makeup_workday, holiday_name`；按實際曆日 join
recommendations.source_history_availability: [人事行政總處年曆](https://data.gov.tw/dataset/14718)列有民國 106～115 年 CSV，免費可追溯
recommendations.cautions: 政府辦公日曆不等同所有民眾工作日；保留修訂版本，週末不等同假日

recommendations.data_and_purpose: 展演結束、舞台節目、交通／水門管制：描述、預測、步行模擬
recommendations.proposed_fields_granularity_join: `event_date, planned/actual_end_at, restriction_id, mode, location, start_at, end_at, published_at`；時間區間重疊 join
recommendations.source_history_availability: [2026 官網](https://taipeisummer.travel.taipei/)、[2026 停車管制](https://pma.gov.taipei/News_Content.aspx?n=E43F2E5AE1223B3D&s=99037D911BF170D4)、[2023 公車改道附件](https://www.travel.taipei/file/34594/)；歷年公告可逐場人工追溯，非完整統一表
recommendations.cautions: 車輛禁行不等於行人水門關閉；活動結束不必等於煙火秒數加開始時間；實際臨時管制未必留存

recommendations.data_and_purpose: 同日其他大型活動、疫情／停運干擾：描述、預測
recommendations.proposed_fields_granularity_join: `other_event_id, venue, start/end_at, published_at, affected_station`；日期＋空間／受影響車站
recommendations.source_history_availability: [臺北旅遊活動與消息 API](https://www.travel.taipei/open-api)及歷年官方公告免費；API 歷史完整性未確認，需逐場交叉查證
recommendations.cautions: 現有 `related_activities` 部分 NULL；只保留有來源的干擾，不能用全年粗旗標取代實際影響，也不要過度塞入參數

recommendations.data_and_purpose: 活動前天氣預報與警報版本：真正事前預測
recommendations.proposed_fields_granularity_join: `issued_at, valid_from/to, forecast_area, rain_probability, temperature, warning_type`；`issued_at <= cutoff` 且有效時間覆蓋活動
recommendations.source_history_availability: [CWA 短期過去資料 API](https://opendata.cwa.gov.tw/dist/opendata-history-swagger.html)、[歷史颱風資料庫](https://rdc28.cwa.gov.tw/TDB/public/typhoon_list/)；免費開放產品可先查，**未確認有完整 2017–2026 預報版本**
recommendations.cautions: 觀測天氣不等於前一天可知；短期 API 不承諾多年歷史，查無歷史可先做回顧模型而非假稱真預測

recommendations.data_and_purpose: Google／社群／公告聲量：預測增補
recommendations.proposed_fields_granularity_join: `query, geo, published_at, collected_at, available_at, cutoff, source_id`；事件前固定窗後以 `event_date + query + geo` join
recommendations.source_history_availability: [Google FAQ](https://support.google.com/trends/answer/4365533?hl=zh-Hant)；[API Alpha](https://developers.google.com/search/apis/trends)仍需申請、近 5 年，不能涵蓋所有 2017 年資料；歷史社群完整性無保證
recommendations.cautions: 現有月指數先查來源與共同尺度；同月多場不能複製月值假裝事件差異；當月包含事後訊息。先驗證相較 OD＋日曆的增益

recommendations.data_and_purpose: 步行路網、各出口／水門開放、觀賞區：流向模擬
recommendations.proposed_fields_granularity_join: `node/edge_id, length_m, access_mode, entrance_id, valid_from/to`；空間 join 後建立 `event_date + route_id + station_id`
recommendations.source_history_availability: [官方出口座標](https://data.taipei/dataset/detail?id=cfa4778c-62c1-497b-b704-756231de348b)免費；[OSM 歷史查詢](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Overpass_API/Overpass_QL#Date)支援當時資料庫版本
recommendations.cautions: 地圖版本不保證當日可步行；目前手繪線、官方推薦步行時間皆非實際軌跡，需現場／管制核對

recommendations.data_and_purpose: 班距、列車餘裕容量、方向與月台到達：候車模擬
recommendations.proposed_fields_granularity_join: `station_id + direction + train_id/arrival_at`；列車到離時刻、載客／下車／上車量、1–5 分鐘月台到達、進站管制
recommendations.source_history_availability: [北捷班距](https://www.metro.taipei/cp.aspx?n=EAD981369A065968&s=0F3F913C344BA050)免費但屬現行概略；[TDX 歷史申請流程](https://tdx.transportdata.tw/about/service)需確認產品、日期、權限及費用；歷史實際餘裕容量未找到免費現成來源
recommendations.cautions: 平均班距不是活動加班車紀錄；列車總容量不是北門可上車容量；全站人次不是分方向月台到達量

recommendations.data_and_purpose: 實測候車／排隊標籤：模擬驗證
recommendations.proposed_fields_granularity_join: 每方向每 1–5 分鐘 `queue_length, arrival_count, boarded_count, denied_boarding, wait_sample`；與班次時刻連接
recommendations.source_history_availability: 未找到可免費回溯的 2017–2026 北門逐分鐘資料；可能需向營運單位申請或未來經同意現地人工計數
recommendations.cautions: 沒標籤只能做明示假設的情境敏感度；不得把逐時 OD 均分後當成實測分鐘序列
